name: Andzani, the Astronaut
shortDescription: Andzani dreams of becoming an astronaut as he explores constellations, spacesuits, rockets, satellites, planets, meteors and the wonders of space.
longDescription: Andzani loves looking at the night sky and dreams of travelling to space one day. As he learns about constellations, astronaut suits, spacecraft, rocket engines, satellites, orbits, the eight planets and meteors, his curiosity grows. With a telescope to help him study the distant sky, Andzani keeps learning while holding on to his dream of becoming an astronaut.
